Rebrander is a Grok Bot for changing your name or your product or company's. It finds every place the old name still shows up online, builds the step-by-step plan and a PDF report, designs your new logo kit, and keeps checking until the old name is gone. https://t.co/khHTWYx77P https://t.co/z83BSoGzMd pic.twitter.com/OvXpScU1Ay
